Уменьшения: «до − после». Прирост соедин: Reductions use before − after. Connection gain uses after − before. Connection opportunities are the sum of n(n−1)/2 over empty cells targeted by n open ends. The bounded bank is min(opportunities, 6) while open ends ≤ 10, otherwise 0; its gain is max(0, after − before). Trapped water has no free neighbour on any of its four sides. Newly trapped water is max(0, count after − count before).
